properties.name: Protobuf_ToolsOs
properties.doc: The OS of the protoc that is run; detected unless set.

properties.name: Protobuf_ToolsCpu
properties.doc: The CPU of the protoc that is run; detected unless set.

properties.name: Protobuf_ProtocFullPath
properties.doc: A protoc to use instead of the one from Grpc.Tools, e.g. on musl or on an unsupported CPU.

properties.name: gRPC_PluginFullPath
properties.doc: A grpc_csharp_plugin to use instead of the one from Grpc.Tools.

properties.name: Protobuf_NoWarnMissingExpected
properties.doc: Do not warn when protoc has not produced an expected file (a .proto without services).

properties.name: Protobuf_TouchMissingExpected
properties.doc: Create the missing expected files empty, so that incremental builds stay incremental.

properties.name: DisableProtobufDesignTimeBuild
properties.doc: Do not generate code during the design-time build of an IDE.

properties.name: IncludeHttpRuleProtos
properties.doc: Add google/api/http.proto and annotations.proto for gRPC JSON transcoding.

items.name: Protobuf
items.doc: A .proto file compiled to C# by Grpc.Tools during the build.

metadata.name: GrpcServices
metadata.doc: Which gRPC stubs are generated besides the messages.

metadata.name: Access
metadata.doc: The accessibility of the generated types.

metadata.name: ProtoRoot
metadata.doc: The folder import paths inside the .proto files are relative to.

metadata.name: AdditionalImportDirs
metadata.doc: Semicolon-separated folders to look for imported .proto files in.

metadata.name: ProtoCompile
metadata.doc: false: the file is only there to be imported by others.

metadata.name: CompileOutputs
metadata.doc: false: generate the files, but do not compile them into this project.

metadata.name: OutputDir
metadata.doc: Where the message classes are generated; obj by default.

metadata.name: GrpcOutputDir
metadata.doc: Where the service stubs are generated; OutputDir by default.
